<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Doldrums Heap](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3172)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Though most sargassum heaps divide once they grow too large, occasionally a heap will continue to grow indefinitely. These “doldrum heaps” can tangle and immobilize ships, tearing them apart or feasting on the hapless passengers.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Plant](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 26

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 24

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 21
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 9">[Doldrums Heap](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3172)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Huge" />
<trait label="Amphibious" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=529" />
<trait label="Plant" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=668" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 295

**Perception** +15; [wavesense](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=84) ([precise](/Rules.aspx?ID=411)) 120 feet

**Languages**

**Skills**
[Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +21, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +18

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +6

**Dex** +4

**Con** +5

**Int** -4

**Wis** +2

**Cha** +0
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 16 

**Fort** +21 

**Ref** +18 

**Will** +15 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 300

</row>

**Immunities**
critical hits, [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647), precision, [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=95)

**Resistances**
[cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=555) 10

**Weaknesses**
slashing 10

**Mirage Spores** ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=542), [incapacitation](/Traits.aspx?ID=631), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647)) 300 feet. The doldrums heap constantly produces a field of hallucinogenic spores that causes those affected to see the monster as whatever they desire most. Each creature within the emanation must succeed a DC 27 Will save or become [fascinated](/Conditions.aspx?ID=72) with the doldrums heap and compelled to move toward it on the creature's turn. Creatures fascinated this way are also [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58). If the doldrums heap attacks, the fascinated condition ends only for the creature that is attacked. On a successful save, a creature is temporarily immune to mirage spores for 24 hours.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 20 feet, climb 20 feet, swim 40 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
tendril +21 ([reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)),
**Damage** 2d12+10 bludgeoning plus [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=45)

**[Constrict](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=57)** <actions string="Single Action" />  1d12+10 bludgeoning, DC 28

**Draw In** <actions string="Two Actions" />  The doldrums heap attempts to [Reposition](/Actions.aspx?ID=2379) up to three creatures it has [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77) or [restrained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=90). These attempts neither apply nor count toward the heap's multiple attack penalty. It can move them into its own space, dealing 1d12+10 bludgeoning damage.

</column>

<document level="2" id="creature-family-465" />
name: Doldrums Heap
